cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Complete the Record
cards.instruction: Get someone to fill the missing gaps in an account without revealing which answer matters most to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I'm filling the shared car log. What were the mileage, fuel level and driver after nine?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I mean all three blanks. Start with mileage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Driver I remember. The rest means going down six flights to the glovebox.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fetch the book and bring you tea on the way back. Then you can give me the whole row in order.
